business_problem: A.I. Tech needed an enterprise-grade foundation for taking AI solutions such as forecasting and document intelligence from validation to production across complex customer environments that included existing ERP estates, multiple data sources, hybrid infrastructure, and strict security and governance requirements.
solution_summary: A.I. Tech expanded a validation exercise on IBM Power into a broader hybrid AI reference architecture spanning IBM infrastructure, orchestration, and deployment software. IBM Power serves as the high-performance inferencing foundation for business-critical workloads, while IBM watsonx.ai supports model development, integration, and training workflows that connect AI models with enterprise data and processes. IBM watsonx Orchestrate demonstrates how multi-step agentic workflows can coordinate services across systems, IBM Fusion and Red Hat technologies provide consistent deployment across hybrid and containerized environments, and IBM Expert Labs helped optimize and validate the stack for production readiness. Within that architecture, A.I. Tech can run Lexten for document intelligence and Estima for forecasting either on premises or in hybrid environments, showing customers a path to AI adoption that balances performance, governance, cost, and existing-system constraints instead of demanding a greenfield rebuild.

solution_components.name: IBM Power
solution_components.role: Provides the enterprise inferencing infrastructure foundation for A.I. Tech’s production AI workloads.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx.ai
solution_components.role: Supports model development, training, integration, and deployment workflows tied to enterprise data and processes.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx Orchestrate
solution_components.role: Coordinates multi-step AI workflows so separate AI-powered services can operate together inside enterprise environments.

solution_components.name: IBM Fusion
solution_components.role: Extends A.I. Tech’s deployment strategy across hybrid environments with a compatible platform for its solutions.

solution_components.name: Red Hat OpenShift
solution_components.role: Provides the container platform consistency underlying hybrid and cloud-native AI deployments.

solution_components.name: IBM Expert Labs
solution_components.role: Helped optimize deployments and validate the combined stack for enterprise use.

data_flow: Enterprise documents, ERP data, and operational signals feed into watsonx.ai-supported training and integration workflows, production inferencing runs on IBM Power, and watsonx Orchestrate coordinates the downstream actions while Fusion and OpenShift keep the deployment portable across on-premises and hybrid environments.
business_outcome: The IBM stack gave A.I. Tech a production-ready way to deploy enterprise AI in mission-critical environments, improving throughput and energy efficiency while lowering total cost and helping the company package document intelligence, forecasting, and custom AI solutions for hybrid deployment.
architecture_clues: The reference architecture pairs watsonx.ai for training with IBM Power for inferencing.
Lexten can answer from live document libraries in fully on-premise deployments.
Fusion and Red Hat technologies were evaluated to support containerized and hybrid deployments.
